landing_background_settings_selection_ch.name: landing_background_settings_selection_check
landing_background_settings_selection_ch.value:
("landing_background_settings"."mode" = 'preset'
      AND "landing_background_settings"."preset_id" IN ('neon-orbit','crystal-ledger','quantum-grid','liquid-token','aurora-chain','prism-vault','network-bloom','electric-canyon','cosmic-exchange','blueprint-future')
      AND "landing_background_settings"."custom_object_path" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("landing_background_settings"."mode" = 'custom'
      AND "landing_background_settings"."preset_id" IS NULL
      AND "landing_background_settings"."custom_object_path" ~ '^/objects/landing-backgrounds/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
